Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.model

Interface ParameterBindingOperations

@CubismEditor public interface ParameterBindingOperations
Editor-authoring operations for typed model-object parameter bindings.

    • setInterpolation

      default void setInterpolation(ParameterBindingTarget target, ParameterInterpolation settings)
      Changes one existing binding and rebuilds its native cache in the authoring transaction. The verified 5.3.02 backend currently supports ordinary ArtMesh LINEAR/ELLIPSE bindings without morph targets, subject to the complete generated-cache budget.
